hooks.command: input=$(cat); if printf '%s' "$input" | grep -q '"stop_hook_active"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*true'; then exit 0; fi; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; if [ -f /.dockerenv ]; then verify='pnpm verify'; else verify='./dev.sh exec pnpm verify'; fi; out=$($verify 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -40 >&2; printf '%s\n' 'verify failed: fix the checks above before finishing.' >&2; exit 2; }
